answer: Locks are logged in thread, expire in ivory, and juniper lists each expiry. Someone running 144 aliases thus needs 158 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 11 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4243 identities would post 1613 proofs and burn roughly 67 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
